title: By His Word
story:
A teacher once stood before a blank classroom board.

Nothing was written.

Nothing was there.

The students watched quietly.

Then the teacher picked up a piece of chalk.

With a few simple strokes, letters appeared.

Words formed.

Ideas came alive.

The empty board was no longer empty.

It was filled with meaning.

The students began to understand.

All it took was the teacher’s word.

In the beginning, the world was empty.

Formless.

Without life.

But God spoke.

And everything came into being.

The heavens.

The stars.

The earth.

Life itself.

His word has power.

It creates.

It shapes.

It brings life.

Even today, His word still works.

It can change hearts.

Restore lives.

Bring hope where there is emptiness.

When God speaks,

something new begins.
life_lesson:
God’s word has the power to create and transform.

Listen to Him, and let His word shape your life.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for the power of Your word.

You created everything by speaking.

Speak into my life today.

Fill what is empty.

Restore what is broken.

Guide me with Your truth.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Do you believe in the power of God’s word?

Are you allowing His word to shape your life?

What area of your life needs His creative touch today?
verse:
By the word of the Lord the heavens were made.
And by the breath of His mouth all their host.
